sin.name: listener-hears-every-model
sin.description: A commit listener hears every model change.
sin.rule: Declare the specific row or domain event the listener needs. Four listeners stay because their model set is open: the sequence end and row trigger listeners cover row types declared by installed sequence steps and triggers, DockItemLeaveListener hears the end of any row a dock item can point at, and SkillEventListener hears any event a skill names in its file.
